title: No Chip and Classic Mani Pedi Services with Gel or Dazzle Dry Options at GlossHaus Nails and Spa (Up to 30% Off)
description:
New guests are invited to experience exclusive first-visit specials on popular nail services, designed to refresh and revitalize. Discover a range of manicure and pedicure treatments that leave hands and feet looking impeccably polished and feeling beautifully cared for. This is an ideal opportunity for those seeking a fresh look with professional care.What We Offer
                        No-Chip Manicure Refresh: Guests receive a simple, fresh manicure including nail shaping, trimming, buffing, and meticulous cuticle care, finished with nourishing lotion and their choice of long-lasting Gel or Dazzle Dry polish for an effortlessly put-together look.
                        
                    
                        No-Chip Pedicure Refresh: This revitalizing pedicure provides a long-lasting gel finish with mirror-shine and chip-free wear for up to three weeks. It features a warm herbal neck pillow, precise nail shaping, meticulous cuticle care, a soothing hot towel wrap, invigorating exfoliation, and a relaxing massage, completed with their choice of Gel or Dazzle Dry polish.
                        
                    
                        Haus Classic Mani Pedi Reset: Experience a comprehensive classic manicure and pedicure. The manicure includes shaping, trimming, buffing, cuticle care, and lotion, while the pedicure offers a warm herbal neck pillow, expert nail shaping, meticulous cuticle care, a hot towel wrap, exfoliation, and a massage, all finished with their choice of classic nail polish.
                        
                    
                        Haus No Chip Mani Pedi Reset: This ultimate reset combines a no-chip manicure and a no-chip pedicure. The manicure features shaping, trimming, buffing, cuticle care, and lotion. The pedicure enhances relaxation with a warm herbal neck pillow, detailed nail shaping, meticulous cuticle care, a hot towel wrap, exfoliation, and a massage, with the final touch of their choice of Gel or Dazzle Dry polish for extended wear.
                        
                    Why You Should Grab This OfferThis offer provides an exclusive opportunity for new guests to experience quality nail services. They can choose from a range of popular manicure and pedicure options, each meticulously designed to deliver a polished and revitalizing experience. The no-chip services offer mirror-shine and chip-free wear for up to three weeks, ensuring lasting beauty. Beyond basic nail care, the pedicures include thoughtful touches like a warm herbal neck pillow, a soothing hot towel wrap, invigorating exfoliation, and a relaxing massage, transforming a routine treatment into a moment of pure indulgence. This comprehensive approach ensures deep relaxation and visible results.Customers benefit from the flexibility of choosing between classic, Gel, or Dazzle Dry polishes, allowing for personalized style and durability. It's an ideal introduction to professional nail care, with attention to detail evident in meticulous cuticle care and precise nail shaping. This deal serves as an invitation to discover a dedication to client satisfaction, making it a valuable choice for anyone looking for a refreshing nail transformation.

review_samples.author: Eva
review_samples.text: Rubi did an awesome job on my manicure.

review_samples.author: Luisa
review_samples.text: Amazing service, and the place is so relaxing. 10/10

review_samples.author: Guest
review_samples.text: The tips of my nails turned black and three of them peeled off... Things were done a little backwards there and I figured I'd give it a shot... A few things went wrong The foot soak started sucking in the plastic bag.. so that was cut short.. it's a brand new place I think they just need to work some stuff out but the no-chip manicure was not good

review_samples.author: kimlewis13
review_samples.text: I would avoid buying this coupon, you get 60ish colors to choose from and they’re all muted, neutral or pastel colors. It was clearly an upsell ploy by the salon cause there were other color selections not available under this deal. The tech, who was brand new, was very nice and did a good job, but overall not worth it with the limited color selection.
